function.name: mcp__lilos__app_launch
function.description: Launch an app inside the LilOS desktop and attach it to this session's workspace.

function.name: mcp__lilos__browser_navigate
function.description: Open a URL in this LilOS session's dedicated browser tab. The tab is owned by the session and visible in the workbench pane.

url.description: Absolute URL to open, including scheme.

function.name: mcp__lilos__browser_snapshot
function.description: Read the current state of this session's browser tab: URL, title, and the visible text content.

function.name: mcp__lilos__file_stage
function.description: Stage a file into this session's scratch area so other tools (or teammates) can pick it up.

path.description: File name relative to the session scratch dir.

function.name: mcp__lilos__notify
function.description: Post a short notification into the LilOS channel this session is bound to.

function.name: mcp__lilos__terminal_run
function.description: Run a shell command in this session's terminal pane. Output streams live to the channel and is returned here.

timeout_seconds.description: Kill the command after this many seconds (default 30).
